table_query:
SELECT
  c.CustomerID,
  c.AccountNumber,
  c.PersonID,
  c.StoreID,
  c.TerritoryID,
  p.PersonType,
  p.Title,
  p.FirstName,
  p.MiddleName,
  p.LastName,
  p.Suffix,
  concat_ws(' ', p.FirstName, p.MiddleName, p.LastName) AS FullName,
  p.EmailPromotion
FROM silver.yasilvermodel.Sales_Customer c
LEFT JOIN silver.yasilvermodel.Person_Person p
  ON p.BusinessEntityID = c.PersonID
column_expressions: CAST(UNHEX(SHA2(CONCAT(IFNULL(CAST(`AccountNumber` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`PersonID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`StoreID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`TerritoryID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`PersonType` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Title` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`FirstName` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`MiddleName` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`LastName` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Suffix` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`FullName` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`EmailPromotion` AS STRING), 'NULL')), 256)) AS BINARY)
create_table_ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gold.yagoldmodel2.DimCustomer (
  `CustomerKey` BINARY,
  `CustomerID` INT,
  `AccountNumber` STRING,
  `PersonID` INT,
  `StoreID` INT,
  `TerritoryID` INT,
  `PersonType` STRING,
  `Title` STRING,
  `FirstName` STRING,
  `MiddleName` STRING,
  `LastName` STRING,
  `Suffix` STRING,
  `FullName` STRING,
  `EmailPromotion` INT,
  `CustomerKey_Id` BIGINT,
  Audit_CreatedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  Audit_ModifiedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  ChangeHash BINARY
)
USING delta
